title: Spring Boot Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Return a greeting
entries.summary: @RestController makes return values into HTTP responses. GET /hello calls this method.
notes: A mapping must use the same path and HTTP method as the request.

entries.name: Return named data
entries.summary: Spring Boot writes a Map as JSON. Open GET /book.
notes: JSON object field order is not part of its meaning.

entries.name: Read a path value
entries.summary: @PathVariable reads a value from a named path position. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
notes: Use the explicit input name so compilation settings do not affect binding.

entries.name: Use a query default
entries.summary: @RequestParam reads a query value. GET /page without n uses the default 1.
notes: Text that cannot become an int is rejected before this method runs.

entries.name: Parse a whole number
entries.summary: An int path input is parsed by Spring. Open GET /double/4.
notes: A type checks the shape, not whether the number fits your business rule.

entries.name: Read a JSON body
entries.summary: @RequestBody reads JSON into a Java record. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: A record defines fields but does not automatically make every value valid.

entries.name: Reject a missing title
entries.summary: A handler can check a body value and send 400 when it is not usable. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: Check input before storing or acting on it.

entries.name: Report a missing resource
entries.summary: ResponseEntity lets code choose a status and body. Open GET /missing.
notes: A failure should not use a success status just because it has a body.

entries.name: Return several records
entries.summary: A list becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books.
notes: List.of makes a list that cannot be changed in place.

entries.name: Set reply metadata
entries.summary: A response can carry cache instructions. Open GET /note and inspect Cache-Control.
notes: Headers need to be set before the response is sent.

entries.name: Return a location
entries.summary: A 302 reply with Location asks a browser to make another request. GET /start ends at /hello.
notes: Redirects are client actions, not calls to another Java method.

entries.name: Handle a known failure
entries.summary: @ExceptionHandler formats one error type for this controller. Open GET /broken.
notes: Do not expose private stack traces or internal values in error replies.
